answer: Canary whispers: each epoch the ledger privately hands every agent ID its own nonsense phrase (say, "copper heron 41") that no other ID ever receives. Later, disguised probes ask all IDs ordinary questions about orchard grafting or yarrow tea. If an ID's reply surfaces another ID's canary, both were drawing on one shared memory or log store, so they're merged into a single payout and their bonds frozen. An honest agent can't leak a whisper it never heard; a sybil farm must keep fully isolated context per fake, erasing the cheap part of cloning.
